transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

My mom made me come. I just... I can't really make myself do anything anymore. I mostly just sit in my room... usually in the same clothes. I used to do things, like knit, or journal... go for walks. But I don't. And when she asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to even answer her.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
A while... I guess since I started that community-college program. That was... about two years and two months ago.

No... not really. I just... I don't really feel much of anything.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No... I don't think so. Just... normal sounds, I guess.
Have you ever felt like people were watching you, spying on you, or trying to harm you?

I mean... I don't know about spying. But... when I was taking those college classes, I could tell what they were doing. The people running the school portal and the clinic practicum... they would change little words in the emails they sent me, or in the comments on my assignments. Just tiny things, but... it was a code. To mark me. To show they didn't want me in healthcare. My mom said they were just regular messages, but... I know what I saw.
Have you ever felt like thoughts were being put into your mind from the outside, or taken away from you?
No... I don't think so. I don't really know what you mean by that. My thoughts are just... mine, I guess.
